caption:
Fifty Christmas word searches for the kids' table this December. 🎄

I made the letters large print, so they're easy to read and easy to solve. Early readers can play. So can grandparents who've put their glasses down somewhere.

There's one puzzle per page, 50 in all, counted, not rounded up. Every page is US Letter 8.5 x 11 in, so you don't resize a thing. Hit print. It fits. You'll get a print-ready PDF plus JPG files, or you can solve them on a tablet in a PDF app.

Tuck a few into stockings, or bring them out for family game night, a holiday party or a long car ride.
